They wave and make peace signs at the camera. The ground is covered in deep white snow, and distant figures are visible. (2) The scene cuts to a wider shot in front of a brick building. Two more people in gray and purple ski gear join the original group, holding snowboards. They all wave enthusiastically. (3) Focus shifts to a male in a white jacket and beige pants. He holds up a snowboard with a white surface and black 'DBC' logo. He gestures towards his pink goggles and pink gloves while the others look on. (4) The male in white pulls out a light blue knitted beanie from his pocket and puts it on. The camera zooms in on his face as he points to the 'DBC' letters on the hat. (5) A split-screen effect appears, showing the male from different angles as he continues to boast about his gear. (6) The group gathers closer together for a final scene where they talk toward the camera, some holding ski poles and others snowboards, with a slightly more serious but still playful posture.
